title: Running prefix sums
hints: Keep a running `total` while you walk `s`; after adding `s[i]`, `total` is exactly `p[i]`. Write into a new slice, not into `s`.
`p := make([]int, len(s))` gives you `len(s)` zeroed slots you can index directly: `p[i] = total`. For `RangeSum`, the sum of `s[0:hi]` is `prefix[hi-1]`.
`RangeSum`: return `0` if `lo == hi`; otherwise start with `prefix[hi-1]` and, if `lo > 0`, subtract `prefix[lo-1]`.
